name: Live Band Karaoke
spec: Voice and guitar, keys, bass, drums, and a host working the mic
alt: A microphone on a stand beside a lyric screen with one line lit in brass, drawn flat on a dark field.
_note: ADDED 2026-09-14 from the corporate demand report. Zero Colorado corporate vendors sell live band karaoke, no Denver-metro act exists on The Bash or GigSalad, and 'live karaoke denver' autocompletes. Daniel folded the 80s and 90s cover-band ideas into this act the same day: it plays as a party band on its own and hands the mic over. Spec'd, no names.
blurb: A party band that plays the 80s and 90s hits on its own, then hands the mic to anyone in the crowd who wants a song, with the words on a screen and the band following whoever is singing.
